_changelog: v1: single generic query per city, city-only radius, no scoring, no fallback (baseline)
v2: comfort-zone category-targeted queries; radius scales with population; added recurring-community sources (BlaBla/Tandem/Meetup/Ostello Bello)
v3: added self-directed POI-anchored fallback for empty/weak weeks; verifiability confidence + confirm-link; difficulty ladder 1-5; recurrence resolution
v4: cross-source dedup (title+date/recurrence key); freshness guard (verifyOccurrence downgrades unverified recurring slots — Ferragosto)
v5: persona/difficulty windows (rankForPersona); safety pass (safetyOk drops 18+/late-night for timid); persona-tuned fallback mission

v6: OBJECTIVE CORRECTION (user) — difficulty is a label, not quality; all comfort-zone kinds are peers; judge = verifiability(45%)+cost(30%)+attendability(25%); diversity (selectDiverse) is the real selector; bring-a-friend is a valid attend mode

radius_by_population.note: small town: must query province + accept recurring/self-directed

comfort_zone_categories.label: Beginner social dance / movement
queries: {city} lezione prova gratuita ballo swing tango

comfort_zone_categories.label: Novel-but-passive (concerts, cinema, exhibitions, markets)
comfort_zone_categories.note: kept as low-difficulty filler / easy-week option, never the only category

aggregator_sources.note: national fallback virgilio.it/italia/{city} covers every comune including small towns

fallback.trigger: no candidate scoring >= 7 on comfort-zone stretch after all categories + radius expansion
fallback.description: Anchor a self-directed comfort-zone challenge to a real POI (from OSM/Places). NOT just 'visit a landmark' (novelty only) — a social MISSION at a real place, so it stretches even where no organized event exists.

mission_templates.template: Go to {busy_central_cafe_or_bar} for aperitivo alone, sit at the bar (not a table), and stay 45 min.
At {busy_central_cafe_or_bar}, order in the local way and start one conversation with a stranger or the bartender.
Visit {notable_local_museum_or_site} solo and ask a staff member to tell you the one thing most visitors miss.
Explore {market_or_park} alone for an hour with your phone in your pocket.

difficulty_ladder.2: public, novel, longer solo dwell (museum, exhibition)
difficulty_ladder.3: among people, structured, low forced interaction (class, communal-table sagra)
difficulty_ladder.4: designed for interaction with strangers (language exchange, beginners' social dance)
